age.evidence: Adult male Wistar Han rats (275-300 g)

sex.evidence: Adult male Wistar Han rats (275-300 g)

dosing.doses_raw: 100 µM or 500 µM (local intra-claustrum perfusion via microdialysis probe)
dosing.evidence: Psilocin was administered at the concentration of 100 µM or 500 µM... locally to the claustrum via microdialysis probe for one hour... dissolved in artificial cerebrospinal fluid (aCSF).

dosing.doses_raw: 500 µM (local intra-claustrum perfusion via microdialysis probe)
dosing.evidence: 25I-NBOMe of 500 µM... administered locally to the claustrum via microdialysis probe for one hour... dissolved in artificial cerebrospinal fluid (aCSF).

handling.evidence: the rats underwent passive habituation to the presence of the experimenter and handling procedure - once daily before the beginning of the experiment.

group_housing.evidence: Upon arrival, the animals were housed in groups of 4-6 per cage... The animals were housed individually during microdialysis experient (housing during testing was individual).

day_night_flipped.evidence: a 12:12 light: dark cycle (direction not specified)

enrichment_housing.evidence: The rats were kept on standard bedding, changed twice a week (no enrichment items mentioned)

assays.assay_description: Direct behavioral observation of wet dog shake (WDS) episodes (rapid side-to-side head/body shakes; equivalent to head-twitch response) for 120 min immediately after local intra-claustrum infusion of psilocin (100 or 500 µM) or 25I-NBOMe (500 µM). Scored by two independent observers; mean count used.

application_type.evidence: Psilocin or 25I-NBOMe were then administered locally to the claustrum via microdialysis probe (intra-claustrum reverse microdialysis perfusion).

setup_habituation.evidence: Paper describes home-cage handling habituation and 2-day post-surgical washout but does not explicitly describe habituation to the WDS testing setup.

setup_restrain.evidence: the animals had unrestricted access to water and food and were allowed to move freely in their cages.

food_restriction.evidence: During the microdialysis procedure the animals had unrestricted access to water and food

water_restriction.evidence: During the microdialysis procedure the animals had unrestricted access to water and food

time_to_assay.evidence: The number of WDS episodes was counted for 120 min started immediately after drug's administration.

sample_size.evidence: Data are presented as mean ± SEM (n = 5-7 per group).

outcomes.summary: All three drug treatments (psilocin 100 µM, psilocin 500 µM, 25I-NBOMe 500 µM) significantly increased the number of WDS episodes over 120 min relative to control, with no significant differences between drug-treated groups.
outcomes.statistics: F(3,20) = 7.698, p < 0.001; psilocin 100 µM vs psilocin 500 µM p = 0.745; psilocin 100 µM vs 25I-NBOMe p = 0.625; psilocin 500 µM vs 25I-NBOMe p = 0.997
outcomes.evidence: All treatments induced head and body twitches (F 3, 20 = 7.698, p < 0.001) which were observed immediately after drug infusion... There is no significant difference between the number of WDS between the three drug administered groups.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The number of WDS episodes was determined by direct behavioral observation, with each full-body shake counted as a single discrete event.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Final WDS value for each animal was expressed as the mean of the counts over 120 min; no within-session time-bin analysis reported.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Only total episode counts reported; no sequence/transition analysis.

B4_ethological.evidence: WDS/HTR is a drug-induced behavioural proxy for hallucinogenic activity, not a natural ethological behaviour (per rubric).

B5_social.evidence: Animals tested individually; no social construct involved.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Behavioral scoring was performed by two independent experimenters by direct observation.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only univariate ANOVA on episode counts was performed.

E1_environment_type.evidence: the animals had unrestricted access to water and food and were allowed to move freely in their cages.

E2_shelter.evidence: No enclosed shelter/refuge described in the home cage during testing.

E3_bedding.evidence: The rats were kept on standard bedding, changed twice a week.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material described in the testing cage.

E6_spatial.evidence: Standard home cage with a single compartment.

E7_social_context.evidence: The animals were housed individually during microdialysis experient.

E8_food_water.evidence: During the microdialysis procedure the animals had unrestricted access to water and food

D1_continuity.evidence: Measurements were conducted continuously for 120 min after each drug administration in a single session.

D2_session_duration.evidence: The number of WDS episodes was counted for 120 min.

D3_recording_days.evidence: each animal was used in a single microdialysis experiment.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline WDS recording reported.

judge_notes: Only one behavioural assay (Wet Dog Shake test) was scored; all microdialysis HPLC measurements are neurochemical (not behavioural) and excluded per rubric.
Route of administration consolidated as 'other' (intra-claustrum reverse microdialysis perfusion) rather than 'i.c.v.', since the probe targets a parenchymal structure (claustrum), not a ventricle.
group_housing scored 'no' because animals were singly housed during the microdialysis/WDS testing period, even though group-housed at arrival (rubric: report housing during behavioural testing).
B4 (ethological) scored 0 per rubric, which explicitly lists WDS/HTR as NOT ethological.
day_night_flipped scored not_reported (medium confidence) — a 12:12 cycle is stated but the direction relative to testing is not.
